description:
Imagine a lifestyle where everything is taken care of.

Located right in the vibrant heart of Rathmines, this innovative co-living community offers an unique living experience.

All-Inclusive Living - No Hidden Costs! Simplify your life with a single payment that covers all your essentials:
-	Heating
-	Electricity
-	High-Speed WIFI
-	Water & Refuse
-	Gym

Premium Development Amenities: This isn't just an apartment—it's a complete lifestyle. 
Enjoy exclusive access to incredible facilities designed for modern living:

-	FREE Gym Access (Classes Included!)
-	Stunning Rooftop Terrace with Panoramic City Views
-	Professional Co-Working Spaces
-	Masterchef Kitchens
-       Multiple Lounges for socialising and relaxation
-	24/7 Concierge & Security (CCTV)
-	Games Room, and On-Site Café
-	Extensive Social Events Calendar - 20 Events per month
-	Secure Bicycle Parking

The Studio: 
Your private, stylish studio is fully equipped with a modern kitchenette and a private ensuite bathroom. Designed for comfort and productivity, it also features a dedicated built-in desk space.

There are 3 categories of studio apartments available:
Pad: from €1995 per month
Studio: from €2095 per month
Abode: from €2195 per month

Prime Location & Connectivity: 
Join this exclusive community in one of Dublin City's trendiest neighbourhoods. Rathmines offers everything you need right on your doorstep, including supermarkets, trendy cafés, award-winning restaurants, popular bars, a cinema, and a library. You're within easy walking distance to the City Centre and benefit from excellent transport links (Luas, multiple bus routes, Dublin Bike and GoCar).

Ready to elevate your living experience? We can't wait to welcome you to the Rathmines House community.

Please Note: The photographs shown are examples. We offer a variety of unit layouts and orientations, priced according to type. Contact us today for details on available units!
